module: 'bigMap' global camera (isGlobal, hidden): perspective top-down view of the big map (the freeroam 'BigMap' mode). It handles zoom (by FOV via manualzoom, from fovMin to fovMax), keyboard movement and mouse dragging, animated recentering (bigMapPan) and keeps the camera within the map limits (mapBoundaries). Mode selection: freeroam_bigMapMode (extension freeroam/bigMapMode.lua) selects it with core_camera.setByName(0, 'bigMap', false, {initialCamData = {pos, rot}}) when the map opens and returns to the previous camera when it closes; it does not appear in the camera cycle (hidden). An orthographic variant, 'bigMapOrtho', exists but bigMapMode.lua has useOrthoCamera = false. The module returns a constructor: require('core/cameraModes/bigMap')(options).
usage:
-- Managed by freeroam_bigMapMode. Access to the instance:
local cam = core_camera.getGlobalCameras().bigMap
cam:panToWorldPos(vec3(100, 200, 0))
notes: setCustomData(data) must receive {initialCamData = {pos, rot}} (starting position and rotation). It computes the point looked at on the terrain plane.
bigMapMode.lua overrides fovMin according to the map size (code comment) and provides mapBoundaries (Box3F); without mapBoundaries, update crashes (self.mapBoundaries:getExtents()).
While the camera is active, the player vehicle's render distance is raised to 5000 m (and restored afterwards).

Zoom: C:zoom(value) accumulates a growing factor (stopZooming += 0.1 per call, then decays) and calls core_camera.cameraZoom; the zoom is centered on the mouse position. The change of zoom step (0, 0.5, 1 depending on fov) calls freeroam_bigMapMode.updateMergeRadius.

Inconsistency: setCustomData(nil) then `camLookAtPoint - self.initialCamData.pos or ...` has no parentheses: the or operator does not protect the indexing of a nil initialCamData; do not call with data lacking initialCamData.pos.
onSerialize/onDeserialized convert mapBoundaries between Box3F and table to survive a Lua reload.

C.desc: Instance of the bigMap camera. Fields: fovMin (25), fovMax (42), angle (53), rotAngle (25), posTransitionTime (2.4), transitionActive, movementSpeed (20), nearClipValue (100), drawIcons, initialCamData, mapBoundaries (Box3F), manualzoom, bigMapCamPosition, bigMapCamRotation.

init.desc: Initializes the default parameters, marks the camera as global and hidden, creates the manual zoom (from fovMax to fovMin).

reset.desc: Resets the manual zoom to zero.

setLevelProperties.desc: Reinitializes (calls init) to apply the level properties (map size).

onCameraChanged.desc: Called by camera.lua when the camera gains or loses focus: on activation, stores and raises the vehicle's render distance to 5000; on deactivation, restores the distance and abandons any mouse drag.

focused.desc: true if the camera becomes active

zoom.desc: Applies one zoom notch (wheel): accelerates progressively and stores the ground point under the mouse to keep the cursor in place.

setCustomData.desc: Receives the activation data {initialCamData = {pos, rot}} from setByName, computes the camera vector toward the point looked at and prepares the zoom.

getZoomStage.desc: Relative zoom level in three stages from the FOV: 0 (close, <= 33%), 0.5, 1 (wide).

panToWorldPos.desc: Smoothly recenters the camera so that the world position (on the ground) is at the center of the screen (bigMapPan.setTarget).

zoomToFactor.desc: Smoothly zooms toward a given factor (bigMapPan.zoomToFactor).

update.desc: Per-frame computation: applies zoom, mouse drag, keyboard movement (MoveManager.forward/backward/left/right), animated recentering, map limits, then writes data.res.pos, rot, fov and nearClip (100).

data.desc: Frame data: dtReal, res {pos, rot, fov, nearClip}

onMouseButton.desc: Called on mouse button press/release: starts or stops the map drag.

onSerialize.desc: Prepares serialization before Lua reload: converts mapBoundaries (Box3F) to a table.

onDeserialized.desc: After Lua reload: reinitializes (init) and rebuilds mapBoundaries as a Box3F.
